# Write-free e2e: flag combination matrix (bead go-foundry-cli-wet.2.2).
# Exercises high-value combinations of --quiet, --verbose, --color, --output,
# --verify, and --dest across subcommands. Invalid combos assert error class
# and exit code 2.

# --- --quiet suppresses non-essential human output (text mode) ---
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --quiet
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --quiet
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec foundry catalog list --quiet
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec foundry catalog show core --quiet
! stdout .
! stderr .

# --- --verbose emits diagnostic detail on stderr ---
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verbose
stdout 'plan_sha256'
stdout 'validate: ok'

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verbose
stdout 'plan_sha256'
stdout 'plan: project='
stdout 'files:'
stdout 'dependencies:'

# --- generate flag surface: invalid combinations rejected before staging ---
mkdir $WORK/bad-gen
! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $WORK/bad-gen/wrong-basename --quiet --verbose
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

# --- --color never/auto/always accepted per subcommand ---
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --color never
stdout 'validate: ok'

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --color auto
stdout 'plan: project='
stdout 'files:'
stdout 'dependencies:'

exec foundry catalog list --color always
! stderr .

exec foundry catalog show core --color never
! stderr .

# --- --output json on catalog show / validate / plan ---
exec foundry catalog show core --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"id":"core"'

exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"command":"validate"'

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"command":"plan"'

# --- --verify default|strict on plan; invalid on validate ---
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify default --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"mode":"default"'

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify strict --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"mode":"strict"'

! exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify default
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

! exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify strict
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

# --- --dest override on validate and plan ---
mkdir $WORK/dest-validate
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $WORK/dest-validate/minimal-cli
stdout 'validate: ok'

mkdir $WORK/dest-plan
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $WORK/dest-plan/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"basename":"minimal-cli"'

# --- invalid flag values assert usage.invalid / exit code 2 ---
! exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --color rainbow
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

! exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify bogus
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

! exec foundry catalog show core --output yaml
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

# --- conflicting verbosity flags ---
! exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --quiet --verbose
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

! exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --quiet --verbose
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $WORK/conflict-gen --quiet --verbose
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

# --- JSON mode rejects human-mode verbosity/color flags ---
assert_exit_code 2 foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json --quiet
! stderr .
stdout '"ok":false'
stdout 'usage.invalid'

assert_exit_code 2 foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json --verbose
! stderr .
stdout '"ok":false'
stdout 'usage.invalid'

assert_exit_code 2 foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json --color never
! stderr .
stdout '"ok":false'
stdout 'usage.invalid'

assert_exit_code 2 foundry catalog show core --output json --color auto
! stderr .
stdout '"ok":false'
stdout 'usage.invalid'
